decisions.rationale: Managed Derby 10.16.1.1 is affected by CVE-2022-46337 when LDAP authentication is enabled. Apache's 10.16.1.2 source contains the fix, but Maven Central publishes none of the required Derby artifacts at that version; the next published 10.17.1.0 release uses class-file major version 63 and is incompatible with the project's Java 17 baseline (major version 61). Retain 10.16.1.1 only until a published Java-17-compatible fix exists or the project Java baseline increases.
decisions.authority: Apache Derby advisory and release artifacts, Maven Central publication checks, and Java class-file verification
